checkpoint: UI-35 · Dashboard craft pass verified · prototype limits recorded

preserved.composition: Greeting/date, decision, large outcomes, activity beneath outcomes, Opportunities heading outside its stack
preserved.goal: 306px closed column; compact main goal above conversation at the same top offset
preserved.paper: Diagonal recess, at most two backing sheets, asymmetric 12/0/12/12 paper and shadow corners
preserved.intent: Only paper moves and actions reveal; summary, status and count remain still
preserved.motion: D-04 reveal: 200ms entry / 160ms return; no mount animation; reduced motion immediate
preserved.actions: Persistent Review path, direct approval/keep-draft/reject only when supplied by the decision owner

runtime_adaptations: One stable portal keeps the actual goal mounted as its column changes width. It scrolls with the closed room and stays above open chat.
Finite-height windows bound the conversation below the compact goal. The companion viewport clips at the workspace boundary, not over the header.
A hero below 580px stacks its summary and paper instead of shrinking meaningful text. This threshold measures the hero itself, not the entire workspace.
Review expands in place on Today, brings the document into view, and returns to the stored main-scroll position and originating button on close.
Pointer movement or keyboard-visible focus is required to raise paper after review closes; layout-induced pointer entry alone cannot reopen it.
Outcome, goal, activity and opportunity examples are fixture slots only. Their production components remain D-09 to D-11.
